questions.question: A square garden has an area of 49 square meters. What is the length of one side of the garden?

options.explanation: 6 meters squared is 36, not 49.
7 meters squared is 49.
8 meters squared is 64, not 49.
9 meters squared is 81, not 49.

questions.explanation: Area of square = side × side. So, side = √49 = 7 meters.
questions.hint: Find the square root of the area.
